mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within 6 months of signal activation, or 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, exceeding a 2% month-over-month decline, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input disruptions and rising costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return differential vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate, exceeding 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances, or signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return differential vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return differential vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.1).
